sloka: परिश्रमात् प्रसुप्ता च राघवाङ्के ऽप्यहं चिरम् ।पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः ।स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसः समुपागमत् ।। ५.३८.२१।।।।
transliteration: pariśramāt prasuptā ca rāghavāṅke 'pyahaṁ ciram ।paryāyeṇa prasuptaśca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ ।sa tatra punarevātha vāyasaḥ samupāgamat ।। 5.38.21।।।।

translations.english: 'Totally exhausted I slept on your lap for a long time, and in turn you slept on my lap later.
